author: Seung Wook
problem: Read N and X. A string is made by writing each letter A to Z N times in a row (A...AB...B...Z...Z); print its X-th character (1-indexed).
bug_description: Uses X // N - 1 as the letter index instead of (X - 1) // N, so it is one letter off whenever X is not a multiple of N.

comments.accurate: Prints the X-th letter of the string where each of A-Z appears N times in a row
comments.wrong_behavior: Picks the letter by how many full blocks of N fit into X, counting from A as block 1
comments.wrong_location: Index arithmetic verified; check that ascii_uppercase is the right alphabet constant here
